ideas.name: 3m box flip
ideas.why: a middle speed between the 1m box (late, noisy) and the 5m (late, slow) may keep more of the move

ideas.name: Heikin-Ashi box flip
ideas.why: the box read on Heikin-Ashi candles (averaged prices) filters single-bar noise before the EMAs see it

ideas.name: flip1 with 1m, 5m and 15m all agreeing
ideas.why: a flip that completes the stack on three timeframes has every horizon's traders on one side

ideas.name: 60-minute momentum
ideas.why: time-series momentum (Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen) at an intraday horizon: an hour's strong move draws trend followers in

ideas.name: VXN jumped, risk-off morning
ideas.why: a jump in the Nasdaq-100 volatility index overnight means de-risking that keeps selling into the morning (a fall, the mirror)

ideas.name: turn of the month, long
ideas.why: the turn-of-the-month effect (Ariel; Lakonishok & Smidt): payroll and pension inflows lift equities in the last day and first days of a month

ideas.name: flip1 with the month's VWAP
ideas.why: price above the month's average cost has the month's buyers in profit and defending; flips with them carry
